title: Epic 35 closure evidence record
description: Deterministic, fail-closed closure-evidence contract for epic 35 (progressive-analysis). The record references only: identifiers, SHAs, CI run ids, release tags, repository-relative evidence paths, reason codes, and explicit nonclaim prose. It never embeds source row material, credentials, or query text. Field order is canonical: the code-unit lexicographic order of field names, applied recursively. The companion prose is docs/evidence/progressive-analysis/epic-35-closure-contract.md and the focused validator is tests/epic-35-closure-schema.test.mjs. This schema uses only the supported keyword subset listed in the contract: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties (false only), items, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, pattern, minimum, maximum, minLength, maxLength. The focused validator rejects any other validation keyword.

base_sha.description: SHA-256 commit identifier (40 lowercase hex) of the immutable base at which the slice was cut. For the origin/main lineage this is the merge base.

child_40_foundation.description: Breadth and receipt foundations that child 40 (adaptive drilldown) must present. Authorization of issue 40 alone does not admit closure evidence.

breadth_gate.description: The controller breadth gate. Parity depth work (38) and adaptive drilldown (40) may not bypass it.

receipt_foundation.description: The evidence and receipt foundations that adaptive drilldown (40) follows.

gated_by_children.description: Canonical ascending set; must be exactly [36, 37] (semantic rule R06).

children.description: Exactly the five children of epic 35, one entry each for issues 36 through 40 (semantic rule R01).

critical_path.description: The declared dependency critical path. Must be exactly [36, 37, 38, 39, 40] in that order (semantic rule R02).

head_sha.description: SHA-256 commit identifier (40 lowercase hex) of the slice head at which the record is evaluated.

nonclaims.description: Explicit nonclaim prose. Each entry states what the record does not claim. The record must carry at least one nonclaim.

terminal_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical serialization of the record with the terminal_hash member removed (semantic rule R07).

evidence_ref.description: A repository-relative path (letters, digits, underscore, dot, dash, slash) or a 40-hex OID. Colons are excluded so URLs and credential material cannot pass.

ci_decision.description: For a merged child: the exact-head and exact-main CI pair, both concluded success. For a closed-no-delivery child: null (semantic rule R05).

closed_rationale.description: For a closed-no-delivery child: the durable closed/no-delivery rationale. For a merged child: null (semantic rule R04).

depends_on.description: Canonical ascending dependency set. Must match the dependency map exactly (semantic rule R02).

evidence_refs.description: Repository-relative evidence paths or 40-hex OIDs supporting this child's closure state.

merged_pr.description: For a merged child: the protected merged PR. For a closed-no-delivery child: null (semantic rule R04).

release_decision.description: For a merged child: an explicit release decision. For a closed-no-delivery child: null (semantic rule R05).
